channel.title: Austin Daily Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Austin Daily Herald (austindailyherald.com)

item.title: Dahle's double double paces Vikings past Loyola
item.description: Austin Dahle’s 10-point, 12-rebound double-double leads Hayfield to a 61-56 home win over Mankato Loyola, with Drew Slaathaug adding 17 as the Vikings move to 14-8.

item.title: Victim identified in Wednesday morning house fire
item.description: One person dies in early-morning fire at Oakland Estates Mobile Home Park on edge of Austin; State Fire Marshal investigating cause.

item.title: Linda Witt-Thurston
item.description: Linda Witt-Thurston, 70, of Rake, Iowa, passed away peacefully on February 6, 2026, surrounded by her children at the home of her daughter in Austin, Minnesota.

item.title: Alumni Update: Hayfield's Beaver leads Norse, Southland's Wolff seizing his opportunity at Gustavus
item.description: From Hayfield's Natalie Beaver leading the Norse to Southland's Eli Wolff seizing his chance at Gustavus, area grads are contributing across college sports.

item.title: Hulne: The small things in sports continue to be the big things
item.description: Columnist highlights three small moments that show why sports matter: a humble hat trick, a senior's tears, and a dance team's shared reflection.

item.title: Twins set to begin spring training, but the offseason isn’t over
item.description: As Twins report to Fort Myers, spring training opens with trade talks still active, surplus outfielders and starters, and Derek Shelton overseeing his first camp as manager.

item.title: Trump orders some U.S. coal plants to keep operating. Will Minnesotans foot part of the bill?
item.description: Trump’s orders to keep aging coal plants running could raise Minnesota power bills, as utilities seek to spread the added costs across the Midwest grid.

item.title: Southland boys pick up 16th straight victory
item.description: Southland boys roll to 16th straight win, dominate Grand Meadow 90-48 behind Tate Goergen's 32 points.

item.title: Riverland women remain winless after loss at Anoka-Ramsey
item.description: Riverland women fall to Anoka-Ramsey 109-29, drop to 0-18; Alexis Jones scores 13 in Blue Devils' latest road loss.

item.title: No. 2 Blue Devils storm past Rams
item.description: No. 2 Riverland CC improves to 25-1 with a 77-58 win at Anoka-Ramsey, behind 17 points from Tyson Helms and a 16-point, 11-rebound effort from Isiah Lindor.
